column1: # Tamil word | meaning [| Telugu equivalent [| ≈ if it sounds alike, or ⚠ note for a false friend]]
# Shown when you tap a word. English loanwords (டீ, பஸ், ...) have no Telugu column.

எனக்கு | to me (I feel / I have) | నాకు | ≈
என்கிட்ட | with me / to me | నా దగ్గర
உன்கிட்ட | with you / to you | నీ దగ్గర
நானும் | me too / I also | నేనూ | ≈
என்னால | by me / I (can) | నా వల్ల
